title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_gatherings_by_flora_shedden_oybwg (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_gatherings_by_flora_shedden_oybwg' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package can lead to complete system compromise, including exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system due to potential persistent control by attackers.
